title: Shipment with enum + record
prompt: Implement in `Solution`: `enum Carrier { Air, Sea, Ground }` with a method `static int Days(Carrier c)` returning 1, 5, 3 respectively (unknown/undefined carrier values throw `ArgumentException`), and record `Shipment(string Id, Carrier Via)` plus `static Carrier Fastest(Carrier a, Carrier b)` returning whichever has fewer `Days`.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Days is a pure lookup; Fastest compares through Days.

tests.name: edge
tests.hint: Enum.IsDefined is the honest guard for cast-in values; ties are unconstrained.
